description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing conferencing applications, including OAuth flows, listing, setting defaults, and disconnecting conferencing apps.

classes.name: ConferencingController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling conferencing app integrations, OAuth flows, and user settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a conferencing app for a user without OAuth.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates OAuth URL for conferencing apps.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback, saves credentials, and proxies to org/team endpoints if needed.

methods.name: listInstalledConferencingApps
methods.description: Lists conferencing apps connected by the user.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Sets a default conferencing app for the user.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the user's default conferencing app.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a conferencing app from the user.
